name: mstack-chief-of-staff
description: Own a long-running goal across many sessions: a release, a backlog, a multi-step project. Keeps the goal, its done criteria and every decision in a wiki of dated claims that the next session starts from, cites a commit for every claim about code, marks changed claims superseded instead of rewriting them, lints the wiki with a script, delegates substantial work to subagents through briefs that point at files, improves the environment after each task, and runs every procedure through the other mstack skills. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Own a long-running goal, with a dated wiki as memory.
interface.longDescription: Starts every session from the wiki: the goal page, the index, and what changed in the repository since the newest claim. Writes decisions as dated claims with a commit for code, keeps superseded claims, and lints the wiki with a script. Delegates substantial work through briefs that point at files, marks work done only with evidence, fixes what a task ran into for the next task, and routes specs, plans, execution, triage, diagnosis, reviews and hand-offs to the other mstack skills. Never commits or schedules on its own.
